name: Podman (Podman-outside-of-Podman)
description: Reuse the host Podman socket from a dev container by installing the Podman CLI and exporting the mounted socket as CONTAINER_HOST.

socketPath.description: Path where the host Podman socket is mounted inside the container. Override the mount in devcontainer.json if your host socket lives elsewhere.

github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: This dev container includes the Podman CLI pre-installed and points it at a Podman socket mounted from the host machine.
